pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: The Bone Stalker replaces an immediate ordinary hit with an animation and delayed damage. Do not mistake the initial wind-up for a miss: retreat until the strike finishes. Its action can apply Darkness and conceal the enemy with Invisibility; regain awareness before continuing a combo.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. $(l:handbook/mechanics/encounters)Starting combat$(/l). In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Music Disc, Bone Stalker Trophy. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Next step
pages.text: This victory belongs to the branch for: Possessed Paladin. The other victories in that branch are also required. Sibling prerequisite encounters can be completed in any order.
